description: PostgreSQL 18 database, column, expression, index, and catalog collation identity
sql: SELECT datcollate = datctype AS locale_categories_agree, datcollate IS NOT NULL AS has_database_collation FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database();
SELECT oid, collname, collprovider, collencoding FROM pg_collation WHERE oid IN (100, 950, 951, 962) ORDER BY oid;
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_collations (plain TEXT, c_text TEXT COLLATE "C", posix_text VARCHAR(8) COLLATE "POSIX");
INSERT INTO type_matrix_collations (plain, c_text, posix_text) VALUES ('z', 'z', 'z'), ('A', 'A', 'A'), ('a', 'a', 'a');
SELECT column_name, collation_schema, collation_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'type_matrix_collations' ORDER BY ordinal_position;
SELECT a.attname, a.attcollation FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid WHERE c.relname = 'type_matrix_collations' AND a.attnum > 0 ORDER BY a.attnum;
SELECT c_text COLLATE "C" FROM type_matrix_collations ORDER BY c_text COLLATE "C";
CREATE INDEX type_matrix_collations_c_idx ON type_matrix_collations ((c_text COLLATE "C"));
SELECT i.indcollation::TEXT FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indexrelid WHERE c.relname = 'type_matrix_collations_c_idx';
